spec.description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for goagain-mcp service tracking tool usage, sessions, and reliability
How many MCP tool invocations happened in the period?
spec.title: Tool calls

spec.description: What share of tool invocations succeeded? 0% with 0 calls means no traffic, not failure.
spec.title: Tool success rate

spec.description: How slow was the slowest 5% of tool calls over the period? Empty (shown as "no calls") when no tools were invoked.
spec.title: p95 tool latency

spec.description: What share of requests to the MCP server succeeded (non-5xx)?
spec.title: Availability (HTTP 5xx)

spec.description: How many MCP sessions are active right now? Depends on the Phase 1 session-metrics fix; stays 0 until that ships.
spec.title: Active sessions

spec.description: Is the MCP service still shipping telemetry? If STALE, every other panel is lying.
spec.title: Telemetry

spec.description: Was the MCP endpoint reachable from outside? 3-region synthetic probe, 5 min interval.
spec.title: Uptime (external)

spec.description: Which tools were used, how often, did they fail, and how slow were they?
spec.title: Per-tool summary

spec.description: How were tool calls distributed over time, by tool? Bars, since sparse activity reads better as discrete events than a line.
spec.title: Calls by tool

spec.description: Which tools failed over time? Empty means zero errors.
spec.title: Tool errors

spec.description: How has tool call latency trended over time, at p50/p95?
spec.title: Tool latency percentiles

spec.description: How many MCP sessions were active, and how many new sessions started? Empty until the Phase 1 session metrics ship.
spec.title: Sessions

spec.description: Transport-level view of MCP traffic (POST /mcp is client activity).
spec.title: /mcp requests by status

spec.description: How much scanner/noise traffic hit unknown paths on the MCP server?
spec.title: Scanner noise

spec.description: How many tool calls are in flight right now? Metric is mcp_tool_active (there is no mcp_tool_in_flight).
spec.title: Tools in flight

spec.description: Did the synthetic probe succeed from each region?
spec.title: External probe success by region
